mathematical_result.compact_smooth: For fixed A=I_3 there are smooth compact cap-one iid marginals with output p_s in C_c^infinity((3,300)), ||p_s||_infinity<=1/2, but sup_x |p_s(x+pi/s)-p_s(x)|>=27/9600, TV(p_s)>=27s/64, and every positive Sobolev norm diverges.
mathematical_result.analytic_schwartz: After independent Gaussian padding of scale s^-3, the marginals are strictly positive real-analytic Schwartz and cap-one; for s>=20, ||p_s||_infinity<=pi and sup_x |p_s(x+pi/s)-p_s(x)|>1e-3, so the sharp-constant analytic-Schwartz subclass is not equicontinuous.
mathematical_result.scope: Refutes only a target-uniform regularity-modulus/Hölder/BV/positive-Sobolev upgrade. Does not refute the QFORM universal density-height conjecture or fixed-instance C0 regularity.

partner_applied.application: At epsilon=1/s, exact heat-height identity plus diagonal height gives ||H_s||_infinity<=pi, while the retained Fourier spike gives ||H_s'||_1>=8s/(27sqrt(e)).

unresolved_implication: Prove one dimension-, matrix-, law-, center-, and scale-independent bound for the positive heat/tent density-height functional without assuming a uniform output regularity modulus or paying a reciprocal tiny-minor cost.
